data.text: Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but I’d rather we keep both the lake and our shares steady. Fishing is my family’s livelihood, and I want it to remain one for the village. Ten tons each earns everyone $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to replenish the lake to 100 every month. Your plan can recover with restraint next month, but why borrow from that catch now? I propose we each take 10 and review the revealed catches together afterward. John, would you support that?
